capability.problem: Recover Fe from fine gangue-rich ore as a separated solid stream without requiring gangue melting, if sustained selective ore-to-path admission can be demonstrated.
capability.current_best: Source credits prepared Fe/CNT transport and electrical collection; HYFOR/Hy4Smelt, MOE, Electra/SIDERWIN and carbonyl routes are comparators, with no established matched superiority.
capability.limitation: Prepared pure-Fe nanotransport does not supply continual oxide/ore Fe admission, accessible connected fraction, purity, durability or a competitive full process.
capability.proposed_mechanism: H2 reduction plus confined moving/regrowing Fe plug and independent conducting wall; isolated electrical-series/material-parallel batch collection. All input/output interfaces remain to be acquired.

target.metric: sustained isotope-confirmed fresh-feed Fe export relative to all accessible preloaded Fe
target.conditions: Immediate proposed coupon gate, with repeated feed contacts and harvests; 10 kg/m^2/h and >=94% recovery are later unachieved targets.
target.comparator: Matched no-ore/preloaded Fe, pure-Fe, bias-off/reversed and blocked-pore controls first; full ore economics against equal-output industrial comparators later.

potential_significance.judgement: Potential fine-ore separation capability if sustained selective admission and complete resource advantage are established.
potential_significance.limits: No transformative recovery/process or energy/cost advantage demonstrated.

scientific_evidence.judgement: Conditional transport/circuit derivations and producer calculators; nanoscale antecedents credited.
scientific_evidence.limits: Prepared Fe antecedents do not validate raw-ore feed or the proposed device.

feasibility_and_readiness.judgement: Model stage only; fresh-source admission, purity, path stability and collector interfaces open.
feasibility_and_readiness.limits: No numerical TRL, prototype, physical test or independent process simulation.

next_step_value.judgement: Isotope-traced export beyond all preload is a decisive bounded test of the missing admission interface.
next_step_value.limits: Passing admission alone establishes neither recovery nor competitive energy; equipment/cost UNKNOWN.

refs.status: Conditional series/material-parallel construction and exact contact/storage conductor bounds.
Candidate, credited antecedents, failed admission/purity/energy interfaces and isotope falsification protocol.
Optimistic conditional arithmetic only; no measured device or independent replay.

next_obligation: Review the stipulated transport/circuit laws and run a frozen <=1 cm^2 isotope-labelled oxide/quartz admission test with all contacts inside a measured V/I/temperature/power boundary. Require feed-derived Fe export beyond 100 times all accessible preloaded inventory, sustained replenishment and repeated harvests, full Fe/carbon/scaffold balance and impurity assay against matched bias-off, reversed, blocked, no-ore and pure-Fe controls. Only then assess untreated real ore, recovery, lifetime and full-process economics.

contract.governing_equations: J=(2f/a) Ds Gamma_s/(RT) [Z*F E-d_x mu]; mu=mu0+gamma Vm curvature+Vm sigma_h+RT ln activity. I=jA/N, V=Nv, P=jAv; P_contacts/A>=sum rho_c j^2/kappa_c; V_gap/A>=j H^2/(sigma eta v)*(N_gap/N)^2.
assumptions: Maintained connected Fe source/sink, actual dirty-ore mobility and open path; no free oxide-to-atom admission.
Linear electrical/transport model, independent material feed/harvest per cell, isolated conducting products during power, finite measured contacts and conductivity.
Clean hot-Fe shell coefficients, solid plug and independently conducting CNT are different models; do not combine their optimistic coefficients.
contract.conservation_and_thermodynamics: Integral export<=fresh admission+preloaded inventory; Fe/gangue/H2/carbon/scaffold mass balance required. Series preserves ideal power. Curvature/backstress can oppose electromigration; no energy saving follows from avoided gangue melting alone.
contract.materials: Fe/oxide/gangue, H2/H2O, CNT/scaffold and impurity transport; actual contact continuity, wet-ore diffusion, dewetting, carbide/wall consumption and product diffusion barriers unvalidated.
contract.units_and_tolerances: Source optimistic T=1163 K,a=L=30 nm,f=.2,3 nm conducting shell,sigma=1e6 S/m,Z*=10 are assumptions. Actual tolerances, contact rho_c and signal uncertainty UNKNOWN.
contract.input_acquisition: Acquire continuing isotope-labelled feed-to-path admission, accessible connected Fe fraction, actual source/sink contact and product removal with impurity and scaffold balance.
contract.error_budget: Exclude all preload/collector contamination, match source temperature and total power, bound isotope/mass/impurity detection, measure local contact losses and path continuity.
contract.energy_balance: Optimistic active ~0.297 MWh/t versus ~0.260 MWh/t avoided gangue duty; no established gain before contacts. Charge H2 generation, ore/preheat/recuperation, every contact/lead, scaffold/carbon, feed renewal, gangue/lost Fe, purity finishing and final melting for equal molten-output comparison.
contract.reliability: Sustained replenishment/harvest beyond preload, preserved confinement and actual mobility under wet H2/ore required; no life/service interval established.
contract.resources: Proposed <=1 cm^2 supported coupon, isotope assay, impurity and carbon/scaffold analysis and simultaneous metered V/I/T/product measurement; cost/availability UNKNOWN.

scaling.manufacturability: Nanocapillary/contact/barrier/seal architecture and source-renewal/harvest process unbuilt.
scaling.supply_chain: Ore/H2/scaffold supply, isotope standards and compatible diffusion barriers require qualification; no procurement claim.
scaling.energy_and_materials: Full reductant/thermal/electrical/scaffold/lost-Fe accounting unmeasured; optimistic arithmetic already gives no established energy advantage.
scaling.economic_comparator: UNKNOWN full cost at equal purity/recovery/product state against HYFOR+smelter/electrowinning or best applicable process.
scaling.maintenance: Coarsening/dewetting/root stoppage, blocked harvest, carbon consumption and replacement intervals unknown.
scaling.environmental_constraints: H2/H2O thermal chemistry, carbon/scaffold balance, impurities, waste and containment remain measured-process obligations.
scaling.scaling_limits: Recovery<=accessible connected fraction; local j/contact loss unchanged by N, product manifold shorts, conductor-volume cost grows with storage time squared, duty costs more heat or installed area.

experiments.prediction: A maintained driven path exports feed-derived Fe beyond all preloaded inventory over repeated source renewals and product harvests.
experiments.equipment_or_data: <=1 cm^2 supported coupon, isotope-labelled oxide/quartz, full inventory assay, impurity and carbon/scaffold balance, calibrated V/I/T and net product measurements; actual dirty-environment mobility required.
experiments.controls: Temperature and total-power matched bias-off, reversed-bias, blocked-pore, preloaded Fe/no ore, prepared pure-Fe source and isotope oxide/quartz; untreated ore only after admission.
experiments.expected_signal: Isotope-resolved feed-derived export >100 times all accessible preloaded Fe and sustained replenishment; magnitude/flux UNKNOWN physically. Model shell preload 9.92 mg/m^2 would empty in ~3.57 ms at the target flux.
experiments.uncertainty: Predeclare isotope detection, all preload/collector inventory, mass balance, temperature/power matching, purity, carbon/scaffold and contact/path continuity uncertainties.
experiments.estimated_cost: UNKNOWN; coupon fabrication, isotope/chemical assay, instrumentation, operators and H2/heat/electricity cost not acquired.
experiments.invalidates: Export no greater than preload, absent feed isotope, stopped replenishment, unaccounted scaffold/carbon or impurity transport rejects/restricts the claimed ore-admission interface. An energy claim fails without the complete comparator boundary.
experiments.procedure: Freeze the source protocol before performance claims; measure simultaneous V/I/T/net isotope product over repeated contacts/harvests and retain every control/failure. Advance to untreated ore only after feed admission.
experiments.acceptance: Sustained feed-derived product >100 times accessible preload with closed declared uncertainty and mass/power boundary. Recovery/purity/durability/full-cost claims need later independently validated gates. Unexecuted.

failures.failure_scope: Oxide reduction, fresh atom admission, connected accessible Fe fraction, impurity rejection and continuous source/sink interfaces are missing; metallization alone does not imply recovery.

failures.failure_scope: Series reduces terminal current by N and raises voltage by N at unchanged ideal power. Every local contact retains j, conducting product manifolds short the series, and storage-spanning conductor volume/heat and duty cycle remain charged.
